intro: Miss Doris started shifting into neutral at every red light and coasting downhill, because the radio said it saves gas. It doesn't, and it's one of 5 habits that wear out an automatic transmission, which on an older car can cost more than the car is worth. Here's what's inside the box, the 5 rules, the honest answer on neutral at red lights, the lower gears, the fluid, and the warning signs. Episode 8 of "Miss Doris's Car".
